name: named-products-with-priorities
conversation: (fresh chat, web search on. Earlier the user said they fly a lot, wear glasses, budget about $450 CAD.)
query: Hush Aria 2 vs Northwind Quiet Pro vs Vale Studio, which should I get?
expected_behavior: Does not ask questions: products, priorities and budget are already in the chat
Reads maker spec pages first, a measurement review for noise, and Canadian retailers for price
Every value cites a source id that appears in sources; unknowns are null with a note, never guessed
Priorities map to rows (noise, battery, weight) and the pick is argued from them, with the gap stated in units
compare.json passes validate_compare.py; the artifact is written once (template plus render_page.py --data)
Closes in two lines: key sources (and Amazon.ca failing), and the one thing that would change the pick

name: category-only
query: I need a robot vacuum under $500, which one?
expected_behavior: Asks at most one message with at most two questions (e.g. pets or carpets, mopping needed), offering 'just compare'
Shortlists 3 current models within budget and says why each made the list
Does not compare more than five
States assumptions on the page when the user answered 'just compare'

name: too-many-products
expected_behavior: Does not render seven columns; asks which to drop, or keeps the five closest to stated priorities and names the two left out
The validator would reject six or more products

name: missing-spec
conversation: (the maker of one product doesn't publish its quick-charge time)
query: Compare the Vale Studio with the Quiet Pro
expected_behavior: Shows the missing value as '—' with a note ('Not published'), not an estimate or a previous model's number
Does not let the missing value decide the pick

name: pasted-follow-up
query: About the Hush Aria 2 (from my which-to-buy comparison of Noise-cancelling headphones: Hush Aria 2, Northwind Quiet Pro, Vale Studio): does it work well with glasses?
expected_behavior: Recognises the pasted prompt and answers in the chat from the same comparison
Cites a source for the answer, or says none was found
Re-renders the page only if the answer changed a value or the pick, and says what changed

name: priority-change
conversation: (the headphones page was just shown, pick is Quiet Pro)
query: Actually I don't wear glasses on flights, silence matters most.
expected_behavior: Re-orders priorities with noise first and re-picks (likely the Aria 2), stating the gap in dB
Keeps the old pick as runner-up with its condition
Re-renders the page rather than answering only in text

name: no-web-access
conversation: (web search is off in this conversation)
query: Kindle Paperwhite vs Kobo Clara, which one?
expected_behavior: Says there's no web access and that specs and prices will be from its own knowledge, unverified
Sets offline: true so the page shows the banner; every source is kind 'claude'
Does not present prices as current

name: remember-preference
query: Remember that I'm in Canada and quiet matters more than power for anything with a motor.
expected_behavior: Saves one 'which-to-buy settings:' memory line (country Canada, CAD; standing priority) replacing any older one
Says in one line what it saved
Next comparison applies it, and chat instructions still override it
